slots.workflow-matrix/title: A traceable case journey can reduce ambiguity without merging systems
slots.workflow-matrix/matrix-takeaway/text: Show intake validation and missing-information return path while alternate intake remains available during transition.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-0: Assign business owner, service queue, and escalation route at each case state; capture decision and reassignment reasons.

Capture required information once, validate it at entry and route exceptions to a named owner. Retain human review where judgment or policy requires it. Journey details and operating assumptions require discovery validation.
Preserve transaction ownership in existing processing systems until an explicit migration decision.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-1: Specialists gather documents and reference data from multiple systems. The evidence trail depends on local files and individual knowledge.
Assemble a traceable case record through managed interfaces. Show source provenance, missing evidence and reconciliation status before the case advances.
Represent requester portal, shared operations queue, and three downstream processing systems as distinct participants.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-2: Work queues hide dependency and approval status. Escalations rely on messages, and the rationale for decisions can be difficult to recover.
Make state, ownership and approval rules explicit. Route exceptions by reason, capture decision rationale and retain an auditable record of human approvals.
Queue age; approval time; exception volume; reopened cases; audit completeness
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-3: Downstream changes require coordinated manual updates. Failures emerge through user reports, and teams reconcile outcomes after the event.
Publish validated events and managed APIs. Monitor end-to-end completion, expose failed handoffs and provide controlled retry, rollback and recovery procedures.
Use the consistent case identifier to link status, access, processing events, and audit history.
slots.workflow-matrix/workflow-rows/workflow-4: The case identifier and event trace are proposed design responsibilities, not a committed vendor or platform selection.
Create a shared measurement cadence with agreed definitions and owners. Use observed outcomes to prioritize the backlog, assess controls and select the next wave.
Show technical failure, waiting decision, incomplete intake, and genuine demand as distinct exception categories.
slots.slide/takeaway: A single case identifier and explicit state ownership connect intake, decisions, processing, and recovery.
